sentences.text: A rock that does not cover is always above water, with its height given above mean high water.
A rock that covers and uncovers is exposed at low tide.
A rock awash is right at the surface at chart datum.
A sunken rock, marked with a cross, is always submerged and may be dangerous.
Wrecks show as a hull symbol when visible and crossed lines when submerged.
Watch for qualifiers: P A means position approximate, P D position doubtful, E D existence doubtful, and Rep means reported but not confirmed.
Treat every one of them as real.
